title: Evidence tiers: only rule-verified claims upgrade to ground truth
context: Hunch records what lessons agents apply to tasks, but agent claims alone are unreliable — they may be false positives, or miss subtle bugs. No way existed to verify lessons were actually applied correctly or to expose trustworthy evidence to external systems. Touches invariant(s): con_7217ab24ab (Regression guard: "Flaky test failure under parallelism: native tree-sitter module resolution race on Windows" must not recur.); con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file); con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Separate evidence into distinct grades: delivered, agent-reported application, rule-supported application (from automatic `hunch task conform`), observed command result, save/commit/push proofs. Only deterministic rule verification — matching a lesson's declared constraint or conformance predicate against the task's actual changed files — upgrades a claim to ground truth. Agent prose, file overlap, or unrelated passing commands alone never upgrade a claim.
consequences: Verifiable audit trail: each evidence grade is labeled with its proof source and confidence level
Prevents false-positive claims from polluting downstream tools (no MCP tool accepts unverified verdicts)
Lessons must declare their own verification rules (constraint forbids matcher, decision conformance predicate) to become ground truth
Automatic verification (`hunch task conform`) runs on finish; violations are shown to the user
Public export can safely omit implementation details while retaining validated evidence
alternatives_rejected: Trust agent-reported applications as ground truth without verification
Single monolithic evidence grade (loses auditability and confidence levels)
Upgrade claims on any agent claim plus a passing unrelated command (false positives)
Expose evidence only internally; keep all details private (limits transparency and reuse)
